phrase: One AI lab warns it is nearing self-improving AI. Its own internal AI use, priced at retail rates, already outvalues what it pays staff.
phraseAlternatives: A leading AI lab warns it may soon build AI that improves itself. Inside the same lab, its AI use, at retail prices, already outvalues what it pays its people.
An AI company says self-improving AI is close. At retail prices, its own internal AI use already outvalues what it pays its human staff.
One lab says AI may soon learn to build smarter AI on its own. At market rates, that same lab's internal AI use already outvalues its payroll.

brief.concept: An AI lab warns it is nearing AI that can build smarter versions of itself, while inside the same company a meter shows what its own AI use would cost at retail prices, already outvaluing what it pays its human staff.
brief.metaphor: A robot on an assembly line bolts together a shinier copy of itself, while nearby a tall glowing AI-spending bar towers over a short stack of paychecks.

brief.composition: Split scene on a blueprint grid. Left half: a robot on an assembly line bolts together a second, shinier robot; a small flag beside them reads SELF-IMPROVING, picked out in the single yellow highlight. Right half: a company building shown in cross-section with two vertical bars side by side — AI SPENDING tall and glowing, STAFF PAY short and flat — a human employee stands beside the short bar with arms crossed, looking at it.
brief.alt: On one side, a robot on an assembly line bolts together a second, shinier robot beside a flag reading SELF-IMPROVING. On the other, inside a building, a tall glowing AI-spending bar towers over a short staff-pay bar, next to a human employee standing with arms crossed.
